contractChanges.MIG-001: The owner's Sentry organization importer runs through Base import-kit's import door (owner-session mount /api/operator/import/*): upload, plan with reviewed fingerprint, apply, reconcile and undo, sharing one history and undo with Business grants. One door namespace per Sentry organization (sentry-org:<slug>); a newer bundle is a reviewed catch-up. The old plan/apply routes are removed; their jobs keep read, originals, resume and undo. Qualification remains synthetic fixtures only.
contractChanges.ERR-009: Native archives written by earlier releases, including CLI exports carrying platform bookkeeping rows, restore into an empty installation of this release.
contractChanges.BASE-DATA-003: Project erasure is accepted as a durable bounded job (202 with Location) and followed to completion by the panel and the scheduled sweep; the five-minute local cap is unchanged and hosted D1 timing is unmeasured.

agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.3.1: export a private archive first (Settings > Download private archive, or rer export --output exports/spool.rer with local dev stopped). Run git pull in the existing checkout, then rer dev locally or rer deploy from the original deploying checkout for a hosted installation. Additive migrations 0044-0048 apply automatically; existing projects, evidence, triage states and project keys are preserved. Keep the existing database, local settings, project keys and deployment receipts; do not reset or restore into the populated installation. Earlier upgrades also apply the migrations described in CHANGELOG.md. Run Sentry imports with scripts/sentry-import.mjs (dry-run, apply, reconcile, undo) against the owner-session import door; the old /api/imports/sentry plan and apply routes are gone, and jobs they created keep read, originals, resume and undo. Archives made by 0.3.1 or earlier restore only into an empty installation. Business grants still require the installation's owner-claim trust bindings (RER_OWNER_CLAIM_*), which self-hosted rer deploy does not declare. The application pins rer 0.2.61. SDK 0.2.0 remains unpublished on npm and is not published by this app release.
publicReleaseNotes: Spool 0.4.0 runs every Sentry history import through one import door: the owner's scripts/sentry-import.mjs uploads an owner-generated organization bundle, shows a plan with a reviewed fingerprint, applies, reconciles and undoes it through the same pipeline Business grants use, and Settings lists every import with its approver and an Undo. Imported issues sit beside new errors in the same project and stay inert. Private archives made by earlier releases, including CLI exports, restore into a fresh 0.4.0 installation, and project erasure now runs as an accepted job the panel follows to completion. Upgrading from 0.3.1 applies additive migrations 0044-0048 and keeps existing data; back up first. The release gate upgraded a 0.3.1 install, restored 0.3.1 archives, imported the repository's synthetic Sentry export locally and on a fresh Cloudflare deployment, and delivered a real new-issue alert email. The importer remains qualified with synthetic fixtures only; no Sentry feature parity, Bugsnag or Rollbar support is claimed. This app release does not publish the SDK.
